name: high_entropy
description: Adversarial workload designed to maximise routing entropy. Diverse topics, variable-length outputs, and high temperature to drive speculative rejection.

prompts.text: Compose a sonnet about quantum entanglement written in the style of Shakespeare.
Explain the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem at a graduate mathematics level.
Write a dialogue between a pirate and a robot discussing the nature of consciousness.
List every element in the periodic table with its atomic number.
